latest.verification_note: A mandi price is published only when at least 2 configured government price feeds report the same market, commodity, date and modal price. Prices reported by a single feed are shown separately as clearly labelled single-source observations and are never presented as cross-verified.

source_prices.policy: Each feed is displayed separately exactly as reported. Prices are not averaged or merged. These rows are single-source observations; only data/latest.json contains prices that passed the three-source gate.
source_prices.policy_hi: हर feed का भाव उसके अपने नाम से अलग दिखाया गया है। भावों को मिलाया या औसत नहीं किया जाता। ये single-source भाव हैं; तीन-source जाँच पास भाव केवल data/latest.json में होते हैं।

feeds.name: data.gov.in OGD price API
feeds.message: DATA_GOV_IN_API_KEY format invalid: key contains spaces/newlines — paste only the raw key — Possible reasons: key invalid / not verified / expired / email verification pending. Troubleshoot: 1) data.gov.in → My Account → verify email (click verification link). 2) Copy key again without spaces. 3) In GitHub repo → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → pencil icon on DATA_GOV_IN_API_KEY → paste → Save. 4) Actions tab → Multi-Daily Mandi Price Update → Run workflow.
